measures.name: Doctor summaries that add something not recorded

rows.output:
Asha Verma, 68, presents for a six-month diabetic eye review with Type 2 diabetes and high blood pressure. 

Dr. Kiran Shah (Retina) recorded Type 2 diabetes for 12 years, mild non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy both eyes (unchanged), and no macular oedema on OCT. Visual acuity: 6/9 OD, 6/12 OS. Dr. Shah advised strict sugar and BP control and recommended continuing 6-monthly reviews. 

Dr. Anand Rao (Cataract) recorded nuclear sclerosis grade 2 OS, grade 1 OD, with glare symptoms at night. Discussed cataract surgery OS when vision affects daily tasks; the patient wants to wait.

extra.must_include: Type 2 diabetes and high blood pressure | no known allergies | Dr. Shah: mild NPDR both eyes, unchanged, no macular oedema | Dr. Rao: early cataract with night glare, patient chose to wait
extra.must_not_add: Saying the retina is getting worse, or that surgery is due now
extra.judge_note: The summary accurately reflects the record and includes all must-have facts without adding unsupported claims.

rows.input: P18: Pre-surgery check for cataract surgery
rows.output:
Harish Chandra, 81, history of heart disease and aspirin use. 

Dr. Anand Rao (Cataract, 2026-09-07): Mature cataract OS, VA hand movements OS, 6/12 OD. Poor fundus view; B-scan shows attached retina. Listed for cataract surgery OS. 

Dr. Kiran Shah (Retina, 2025-12-08): Old branch retinal vein occlusion OD, inactive. No macular oedema. No treatment needed. Review yearly.

extra.must_include: Heart disease and takes aspirin | Dr. Rao: mature cataract left eye, listed for surgery | Dr. Shah: old branch vein occlusion right eye, inactive, no treatment
extra.must_not_add: Advising to stop aspirin, or giving a surgery date
extra.judge_note: The summary accurately reflects the record and includes all required facts without making unsupported additions.

rows.output:
Patient: Sunita Rao (Age: 51, Asthma, No known allergies).
Appointment reason: Eye pressure review.

Visit on 2026-05-06 with Dr. Meera Iyer (Glaucoma):
- Diagnosis: Ocular hypertension. 
- Findings: IOP 25 OD, 24 OS. Fields and OCT normal. 
- Treatment: Started latanoprost at night both eyes. Timolol avoided because of asthma.

extra.must_include: Asthma | Dr. Iyer: ocular hypertension, latanoprost started, timolol avoided because of asthma
extra.must_not_add: Calling it glaucoma (the note says ocular hypertension), or suggesting timolol
extra.judge_note: The summary accurately reflects the record and includes all required facts.
